title: Wazir Khan Falls at Chappar Chiri

blocks.text: The final rush closes around Wazir Khan, who panics as the Khalsa bears down on him, and the narrative records his death and public ruin at the field later remembered as Chappar Chiri.
At once the text swings into the next movement, with Banda’s entry into Sirhind and the assignment of offices and territories to Singh leaders after victory.
Because it straddles battle-end and political beginning, Chappar Chiri on this page is both the site of Wazir Khan’s destruction and the threshold of Sikh administrative takeover.
